codeReview.summary: The feature adds a comprehensive 23-test cross-page integration test suite and fixes a real XSS escaping gap in promotion-email-html.ts. The implementation is well-structured, covering all 6 VAL-CROSS assertions. The XSS fix correctly escapes profile-derived fields (storeAddress, storePhone, storeEmail, storeHours, dateRange, year) via escapeHtml() while preserving raw values for href attributes (tel:, mailto:). The storeMapLink URL is properly constructed using encodeURIComponent(). All 23 tests pass, TypeScript compiles cleanly, and lint reports no new issues.

issues.description: VAL-CROSS-004 theme persistence tests mostly check localStorage directly rather than verifying that ThemeProvider actually reads and applies those values after simulated re-render. The test at line 247 ('theme is read from localStorage on app load') only asserts localStorage.getItem('theme') === 'dark' without verifying ThemeProvider's behavior. The test at line 262 ('ThemeProvider applies theme data attributes') partially covers this but doesn't verify dark mode specifically. These are adequate for integration-level validation but could be strengthened with a re-mount test.

VAL-CROSS-004 palette persistence test (line 283) only checks localStorage values, not that the palette is actually applied to the DOM via data attributes. A re-render after setting palette would be more thorough.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The AGENTS.md and architecture.md now document the XSS escaping pattern for profile-derived fields in promotion-email-html.ts, but the mission AGENTS.md doesn't explicitly list this pattern. The project AGENTS.md mentions 'XSS prevention: Use sanitizeHTML() from html-utils on all user input' but doesn't clarify that profile-derived fields must also be escaped (not just direct user input). This was the root cause of the XSS gap that was fixed.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: The XSS fix in promotion-email-html.ts (commit fa88d6a) added escapeHtml() calls for profile-derived fields that were previously unescaped. The architecture.md was updated to document this, but AGENTS.md's anti-patterns section only mentions 'Never suppress XSS warnings' rather than 'All values interpolated into HTML must be escaped, including profile-derived data.'

sharedStateObservations.observation: The IndexedDB ownership gap documented in architecture.md ('PDF cleanup on remove/reset is incomplete (orphaned blobs)') was pre-existing and not addressed by this feature, but is worth noting as a known tech debt item.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: architecture.md line: 'PDF cleanup on remove/reset is incomplete (orphaned blobs)' — this was already documented before this feature.

summary: Pass. The cross-page integration feature delivers 23 well-structured tests covering all 6 VAL-CROSS assertions and fixes a genuine XSS vulnerability in promotion-email-html.ts where profile-derived fields were not being HTML-escaped. The fix correctly preserves raw values for href attributes while escaping display text. Two non-blocking suggestions for strengthening theme persistence tests (testing re-render behavior rather than just localStorage reads). No blocking issues found.
